Name: Olden Baths
Author: HazelNuttAndFrog
Description:
[left][color=#d8d8d8]Hi, hello 🙈[/color][/left]

[color=#d8d8d8]Here I am again, still on my quest to replace as many blues as possible with green and yellow, I guess 😅.[/color]

[color=#d8d8d8]This is a very simple mod that aims to make the Spa look a bit cozier and a little more [i]olden[/i].[size=3] It[/size]'s inspired by real life [url=https://historicpools.org.uk/member_pools/victoria-baths-manchester/]Edwardian[/url] [url=https://historicpools.org.uk/member_pools/moseley-road-baths-birmingham/]public[/url] [url=https://historicpools.org.uk/member_pools/carlisle-public-baths/]baths[/url]. I must have seen the movie [i]Deep End[/i] at an impressionable age, because that beautiful, dilapidated, bathhouse has been haunting me ever since, even in Stardew Valley (never been to a real Edwardian bathhouse, though). [/color]

[color=#d8d8d8]This only changes the tilesheet colours; I didn't touch the map! It shouldn't conflict with mods that do change it (I tried to keep things simple, just in case!), unless they add some extra tilesheets that I don't know about 😅.



[i]*Nota del tilesheet en español: Cambié los F y M de las puertas por D y C. Me pareció que Damas y Caballeros ayudaba a completar esa sensación nostálgica, pero si no se entiende, puedo volver a agregar la versión original [/i]😅[/color]


[line]


[color=#d8d8d8][size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#d8d8d8]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], if you haven't already.[/color]
[color=#d8d8d8]Download and unzip this mod, then drop it into your Mods folder.[/color]
[color=#d8d8d8]Enjoy![/color]

[color=#d8d8d8]You'll need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] to toggle the lighting. It's set to Moody by default.[/color]



[color=#d8d8d8][size=4][b]Known Issues[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#d8d8d8]There's a stool in the women's locker room that looks a bit cut off. The same thing happens with the vanilla stool, so this is an issue with the vanilla map itself, not with the recolour :([/color]
